traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You don't think twice when someone needs help.

traits.name: Impulsive
traits.description: You act first and think later. Sometimes it works!

traits.name: Cautious
traits.description: You measure every step before taking it.

traits.name: Loyal
traits.description: Your friends know they can always count on you.

traits.name: Patient
traits.description: You know how to wait for the right moment.

traits.name: Gentle
traits.description: Your kindness calms everyone around you.

traits.name: Timid
traits.description: It's hard for you to take the first step, but you feel deeply.

traits.name: Mischievous
traits.description: You always have a joke ready.

traits.name: Serene
traits.description: You keep calm when things get complicated.

traits.name: Clever
traits.description: You see solutions where others see problems.

traits.name: Cheerful
traits.description: You spread energy wherever you go.

traits.name: Tenacious
traits.description: Giving up isn't in your plans.

traits.name: Proud
traits.description: You push yourself to be the best, and you almost always are.

traits.name: Lone Wolf
traits.description: You do your own thing and don't care.

traits.name: Chaotic
traits.description: Not even you know what you'll do next.

personalityTest.question: There's a fight in the middle of town! What do you do?

answers.text: I jump in to help without thinking.
I look for someone who can stop it.
I watch everything from afar.
I laugh and cheer both of them on.

personalityTest.question: You find a wallet on the ground.

answers.text: I take it to the police right away.
I look for its owner even if it takes hours.
First I check what's inside…
I don't even touch it, just in case.
An adventure with no plan at all.
Reading, thinking, being calm.
Hanging out with all my friends.
Training to get better.

personalityTest.question: You have an important exam tomorrow.

answers.text: I study until late at night.
I review just enough: I trust myself.
I get really stressed.
Exam? I'll see tomorrow.

personalityTest.question: What do your friends say about you?

answers.text: That I'm the funniest one in the group.
That they can always count on me.
That I'm a bit mysterious.
That I never give up.

personalityTest.question: The path splits: one dark and short, the other long and sunny.

answers.text: The dark one, more excitement!
The long one, no rush.
I sit down to think it over.
Neither: I make a new shortcut.

personalityTest.question: Someone mocks you in front of everyone.

answers.text: I answer back on the spot.
I ignore them completely.
It hurts, even if I don't say it.
I hit back with a better joke.
Friendship.
Freedom.
Calm.
Being the best.
